description: Retail postage for one letter, postcard or large envelope (flat) by weight, to the US, Canada, Mexico or any other country, with the nonmachinable surcharge for square or rigid cards, the total for a quantity, and the number of Forever stamps per piece. nonmachinable.description: True for square, rigid, lumpy or vertical letters and cards (adds the surcharge).

quantity.description: Number of identical pieces, for example 40 holiday cards. Default 1.
